decisions.reason: As the flagship closely building on core messaging expertise, its high relatedness enables effective learning and improvement, so the firm keeps it.
Document capture builds on existing document workflow and file exchange knowledge, giving the firm the capacity to assimilate feedback and refine the service, so it is retained.
Email-to-fax conversion leverages established messaging channels, allowing the firm to interpret customer needs and enhance the service, so it is kept.

Although it is close to the established fax offer and thus easy to evaluate, the firm's related knowledge shows the optimization feature is better integrated into the core fax platform, so it is dropped as a standalone product.
Email sandbox threat protection builds directly on the firm's security knowledge, enabling it to learn from early results and continue improving the product, so it is kept.
